segments.description: Designs, manufactures and sells commercial and residential water treatment products and systems for filtration, softening and foodservice applications.
segments.evidence: This segment designs, manufactures and sells commercial and residential water treatment products and systems including pressure tanks, control valves, activated carbon products, commercial ice machines, conventional filtration products, and point-of-entry and point-of-use water treatment systems.

segments.name: Pool
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and sells energy-efficient residential and commercial pool equipment and accessories for maintenance, repair, renovation and construction.
segments.evidence: This segment designs, manufactures and sells a complete line of energy-efficient residential and commercial pool equipment and accessories including pumps, filters, heaters, lights, automatic controls, chlorinators, automatic cleaners, maintenance equipment and pool accessories.
